items.item_text: Master’s degree in a related field or a combination of education and/or additional job-related experience that may be substituted in lieu of the degree.
Minimum of seven (7) years of not-for-profit fundraising and development experience.
Minimum of five (5) years of management experience.

Leads the development and execution of comprehensive annual fundraising strategies for both foundations, aligning philanthropic priorities with the clinical, operational, and strategic needs of their supported hospitals and communities.

Provides strategic leadership across two distinct foundations, preserving their unique donor relationships, community identities, financial structures, and Boards of Directors while identifying opportunities for collaboration and shared best practices.

Serves as an active member of the hospital leadership councils for Sequoia Hospital and Dominican Hospital and as the primary liaison to both Foundation Boards of Directors, fostering strategic alignment, communication, and engagement.
Provides direct leadership and supervision to the Foundation Directors and philanthropy teams across both locations, while overseeing the effective allocation of human and financial resources.
Serves as the senior major gifts and planned giving officer for both foundations, actively managing a portfolio of prospects and donors and cultivating significant philanthropic relationships.

Identifies opportunities to create greater efficiency and alignment across shared philanthropic functions, including communications, grants, and annual giving, while maintaining dedicated fundraising strategies within each community.

Builds a strong presence in both the Redwood City and Santa Cruz communities, developing trusted relationships with donors, community leaders, physicians, hospital executives, and other key stakeholders.

Brings an innovative, growth-oriented approach to philanthropy, leveraging successful practices across both foundations and navigating the broader health system to expand donor engagement and philanthropic impact.
